task.description:
Update documentation and requirement status after successful implementation and test verification of API-11 (OpenAPI specification).

Actions required:
1. Update docs/status/requirement_status.json for API-11 to status RELEASED
2. Add implemented_in, test_spec, test_run, released_at, release_run, and last_updated fields
3. Update CHANGELOG.md with an API-11 entry
4. Because this is a WF-02 run with estimation.json present, run retrospective procedure and write docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-api11-20260523.json

Use artifacts from prior steps for implemented file list and test report references.

result.summary: Updated API-11 requirement status to RELEASED with implementation/test/release metadata, added Stage 4 changelog entry, and completed WF02-api11 retrospective including one D2 estimation-rule adjustment.
